    cycle = c['cycle']
    phase = step_count % (2 * cycle)
    overlap = c.get('overlap', 10)
    speed = c.get('speed', 10.0)
    torque = c.get('torque', 1000.0)
    if phase < cycle:
        # Activate main pad and rotate upward

        if phase > overlap:

        sandbox.set_motor(joint, -speed, torque)
